- scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh:201-203 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The `^- none$` arm of the `sandbox_excluded_nothing_committed` regex treats a committed root file whose path is exactly `none` as "nothing committed", because `scripts/review_commit_changes.sh:665-670` records that file as the line `- none`, the same line as the no-commit sentinel at line 529.
  WHY: When the editor summary says `not-edited` and lists a `sandbox-excluded path` finding, the step would append the `review_editor_sandbox_path_excluded` marker even though a real commit landed, and the identical-failure cap would then label the head `ai:review-blocked`; no test covers a real committed path of `none`. Both flagging reviewers rated it MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash checked this claim and said it cannot happen: an extension-less root `none` fails `allowed()` in scripts/review_untrusted_workspace.py:32-33. They downgraded it to a hardening suggestion, gating on `DID_COMMIT`.
- agents.d/8321-review-editor-claude-docs.md:2 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The fragment still lists only blank, `- none` or `- commit skipped (...)` lines as "no committed path". The last run added a third accepted line, `^- none \(edits withheld for safety: .*\)$`, at scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh:202, with a test parameter at tests/test_review_editor_sandbox_excluded_escalation.py:169.
  WHY: This is documentation drift only: scripts/review_commit_changes.sh:151 writes the withheld line only when partial finalize is requested, and the step's `if:` at .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:3834 (`env.AUTOFIX_PARTIAL_FINALIZE_REQUESTED != 'true'`) excludes that case. All reviewers rated it NIT. Confidence ranged from 3 (minimax) to 4 (sonnet, glm).
